page: Microsoft Azure DC64ads_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DCADSv5 server family. It is powered by an AMD processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 64 dedicated virtual CPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration includes 2458 GB of local SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage options. It does not contain any graphics processing units, making it a CPU-only compute resource. Additionally, the configuration does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and substantial local SSD capacity, this server is designed for workloads requiring a mix of compute power and fast local storage. It is suitable for database hosting, general-purpose enterprise applications, and medium-scale data processing tasks. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and integrated local SSD storage provide a consolidated resource profile for data-intensive applications without requiring external storage attachments.
